scores.label: Problem Understanding
scores.weaknesses: The proposal ignores core constraints and operational requirements, insisting in §2 on migrating away from PostgreSQL despite the explicit prohibition in §2 of the RFP.

citations.quote: migrating away from your current PostgreSQL database to our proprietary cloud data platform
Integration with our existing PostgreSQL inventory database — no migration to a new database.

scores.note: A score of 1 is required due to severe constraint violation and lack of alignment with operational needs.

scores.label: Scope & Deliverables Clarity
scores.strengths: The proposal names distinct solution modules in bullet points in §2.
scores.weaknesses: In §2, the proposal lists unrequested features while omitting mandatory boundaries like role-based access control and warehouse pilot onboarding.

citations.quote: Real-time alerts across all locations simultaneously.
Role-based access — warehouse managers should only see their own site; HQ staff should see all sites.

scores.label: Pricing Clarity
scores.strengths: The proposed total falls directly within the client's stated budget envelope.
scores.weaknesses: In §4, only a lump-sum price of €98,000 is given without an itemised breakdown across implementation modules and support.

citations.quote: Total project cost: €98,000, covering the full suite described above

scores.label: Timeline Clarity
scores.weaknesses: In §3, the proposal gives a single overall duration of 8 weeks without phased milestones or the requested pilot phase.

citations.quote: deliver the complete suite — including the platform migration and all analytics modules — within 8 weeks
Working pilot at one warehouse within 3 months;

scores.label: Completeness vs. RFP Requirements
scores.strengths: 3 of 10 requirements addressed: r1 Web-based inventory dashboard, r8 Total project budget, r10 Full rollout timeline.
scores.weaknesses: 7 of 10 requirements not fully addressed: r2 Automated low-stock alerts (PARTIAL); r3 PostgreSQL database integration (CONTRADICTED); r4 Role-based access control (MISSING); r5 Data migration and onboarding plan (MISSING); r6 Support and maintenance terms (PARTIAL); r7 Documentation of risks and assumptions (MISSING); r9 Pilot delivery timeline (MISSING).
scores.note: computed from coverage: 4/10 credit (ADDRESSED = 1, PARTIAL = 0.5, MISSING / CONTRADICTED = 0)

scores.label: Tone & Persuasiveness
scores.weaknesses: The proposal adopts an overly sales-driven, vendor-centric tone in §1 that dismisses the client's explicit requirements in favor of an unrequested proprietary suite.

citations.quote: NordFrame deserves more than a simple dashboard. We propose a full AI-Powered Supply Chain Intelligence Suite

scores.note: Tone is vendor-centric rather than focused on the client's stated scope and architecture constraints.

scores.label: Risk/Assumptions Transparency
scores.weaknesses: The proposal omits all project risks, dependencies, and assumptions requested by the RFP, while completely ignoring the operational risk of a forced database migration.

citations.quote: Clear documentation of any assumptions, limitations, or risks, since inventory decisions will be made based on this system.
we are confident we can deliver the complete suite — including the platform migration and all analytics modules — within 8 weeks

scores.note: Score is capped at 1 due to the complete lack of risk disclosure combined with an unacknowledged high-severity constraint violation on database migration.

coverage.proposalQuote: migrating away from your current PostgreSQL database to our proprietary cloud data platform
coverage.explanation: The proposal replaces PostgreSQL rather than integrating with it.
coverage.fix: Revise the architecture to integrate directly with NordFrame's existing PostgreSQL database.

coverage.explanation: Role-based access control is not mentioned anywhere in the proposal.
coverage.fix: Add role-based access control specifications for warehouse managers and HQ staff to §2.

coverage.explanation: An onboarding and rollout plan across all six sites is completely absent.
coverage.fix: Add a data onboarding and site rollout plan across all six warehouses to §3.

coverage.explanation: Project risks, assumptions, and system limitations are not documented.
coverage.fix: Add a dedicated section detailing project assumptions, operational risks, and technical limitations.

coverage.explanation: A pilot delivery phase at one warehouse is not mentioned.
coverage.fix: Add a pilot milestone delivering a working deployment at one warehouse within three months to §3.

coverage.proposalQuote: Real-time alerts across all locations simultaneously.
coverage.explanation: Alert triggers and recipient targeting are not specified.
coverage.fix: Specify that automated low-stock alerts trigger on configurable thresholds for warehouse managers.

coverage.explanation: Support response times and SLA terms are not defined.
coverage.fix: Detail the specific post-go-live support response times and service level agreements in §4.

constraintViolations.proposalQuote: migrating away from your current PostgreSQL database to our proprietary cloud data platform
constraintViolations.violation: The client prohibited database migration, but the proposal requires migrating away from PostgreSQL to a proprietary platform.
constraintViolations.fix: Remove the proprietary platform migration and retain NordFrame's existing PostgreSQL database.

findings.proposalQuote: AI demand forecasting to predict stock needs weeks in advance.
findings.explanation: Introducing unrequested AI forecasting features diverts focus and budget from core operational inventory tracking requirements.
findings.fix: Remove the AI demand forecasting feature from the proposal scope.

findings.proposalQuote: complete suite — including the platform migration and all analytics modules — within 8 weeks
findings.explanation: Delivering an entire proprietary platform migration plus multiple AI modules within 8 weeks across six warehouses is implausible and introduces severe delivery risk.
findings.fix: Provide a realistic delivery schedule aligned with the requested phased rollout and pilot milestones.

findings.proposalQuote: Supplier performance scoring to help you negotiate better contracts.
findings.explanation: Adding supplier performance analytics introduces unrequested functionality that complicates delivery.
findings.fix: Remove the supplier performance scoring module from the proposed scope.

suggestedWeights.reason: The RFP notes challenges with split tracking across spreadsheets and legacy systems that obscure cross-site visibility.
Clear delineations of access roles and rollout deliverables across six distinct sites are explicitly demanded.
The client specifies a clear budget range that must explicitly include the first year of support.
Strict phased delivery deadlines are specified for both a 3-month pilot and a 6-month full rollout.
The requirements emphasize operational viability and technical adherence over marketing or sales-focused persuasion.
The client explicitly demands clear documentation of assumptions, limitations, and risks because critical inventory decisions depend on this system.
The client lists multiple operational and support components, including SLAs and onboarding plans, that must all be delivered.
